title: 第15章 黑大赶到救下赵凡第16章 赵凡拜师任务完成
slug: 签到大帝修为开局收下禁忌剑体
content_zh:
一道如黑色魔神般的铁塔身影降临在房间中。
来者正是前来替秦天阳找寻弟子的黑大。
当他根据秦天阳给的信息，赶到天风城用通天九重天的庞大神识看到这一幕时差点给他吓坏。
若是主人知道自己的弟子出了三长两短，怕是要拆了他不可，将其回炉重造。
“还好及时赶到了！”
黑大来到床前，用手抹了一把额头的冷汗。
由于黑大的及时出手，赵家三长老的邪功被打断，差点被牵引而出的九阳神眸重新回到赵凡体内，此时的赵凡只是虚弱昏过去了。
黑大屈指一弹，一道充满了生命力的气息被打入赵凡体内。
不多久，赵凡悠悠醒来，只是脸色还有些苍白。
他只记得自己好像快要死了，然后，听到了一声怒吼。
再次醒来发现身边站着一位粗犷的大汉，凶神恶煞，但是给他一种浓浓的安全感。
而那些想害他的赵家人此刻一个都没看见，应该是这位前辈救了他，正欲开口说话。
“你是谁？胆敢闯进我赵家府邸，不知道我赵家乃是天风城第一家族吗？”
一道气急败坏的声音响起，刚刚被这一幕吓到的赵空开口说话。
他双眼快要愤怒地喷出火，就差一点啊，就差一点，他就能拥有这绝世神瞳。
却没想到，关键时刻被这人给出手突袭搅黄了。
“我劝你现在最好束手就擒，否则我会让你生—”
砰！
赵空话还没说完，就变成了一团血雾。
黑大收回手，看向赵凡开口道：“这人一直都这么勇吗？”

赵凡起身对着黑大行礼：“多谢前辈救命之恩，此人不过是一个被欲望控制的宵小之辈罢了。”
“知道为何我会来救你吗?”
“不知？不过前辈既然救了我，那么我这条命就是前辈的了，但是前辈若是让我做一些邪恶之事，还请前辈恕难从命。”
赵凡从未与此人见过面，此人既然愿意救他，说明必有缘由。
黑大闻言，眼中满是赞赏。
不错！
知恩图报，有原则，而且天赋还极为强大。
只有我主人才适合教导此人！
黑大正欲开口，说明缘由时，刚刚被黑大气势扫飞出去的赵家众人又冲了进来。
此时赵空的母亲冲了进来，扫视屋内，发现只有两人，一人是赵凡，另一人应该是刚刚偷袭之人。
并没有发现她的天骄儿子，然后目光看向旁边一团洒落在地的血雾，似乎明白了什么。
“空儿！”
突然，一声凄惨无比的叫声响彻赵家府邸上空。
赵空母亲双眼赤红，显露元神境五重天的修为，裹挟着阵阵风声杀向赵凡。
赵空父亲也紧随其后。
“我要你死！”
她的儿子死了，那个在她幻想中未来将会名扬天下的儿子就这么变成一团血雾了。
若不是这个小畜生她儿子又怎么会惨死，一定是这个小畜生请来的此人。
先杀赵凡！
再杀黑衣大汉！
content_en:
A black demon-like iron tower figure descended into the room.
The visitor was Hei Da who came to find a disciple for Qin Tianyang.
When he rushed to Tianfeng City based on the information given by Qin Tianyang and saw this scene with his huge spiritual consciousness reaching the ninth level of the sky, he was almost frightened.
If the master knew that his disciple had some shortcomings, he would probably have to tear him down and rebuild him.
"Fortunately, I arrived in time!"
Hei Da came to the bed and wiped the cold sweat from his forehead with his hand.
Due to Hei Da's timely action, the evil skills of the third elder of the Zhao family were interrupted, and the Nine Sun Divine Eyes that were almost pulled out returned to Zhao Fan's body. At this time, Zhao Fan was just weak and passed out.
Hei Da flicked his finger, and a breath full of vitality was injected into Zhao Fan's body.
Not long after, Zhao Fan woke up leisurely, but his face was still a little pale.
He only remembered that he seemed to be dying, and then he heard a roar.
When he woke up again, he found a rough man standing next to him. He had a fierce look, but it gave him a strong sense of security.
None of the Zhao family members who wanted to harm him were seen at the moment. It was probably this senior who had saved him and was about to speak.
"Who are you? You dare to break into my Zhao family's residence. Don't you know that my Zhao family is the first family in Tianfeng City?"
An angry voice sounded, and Zhao Kong, who was just frightened by this scene, spoke.
His eyes were about to burst out with fire. He was just a little bit close, just a little bit close, and he would be able to possess this peerless divine pupil.
But he didn't expect that he would be disturbed by this person's sudden attack at the critical moment.
"I advise you to stay put now, otherwise I will make you suffer—"
Bang!
Before Zhao Kong finished speaking, he turned into a ball of blood mist.
Hei Da took back his hand, looked at Zhao Fan and said, "Has this person always been so brave?"
Zhao Fan stood up and saluted Hei Da: "Thank you, senior, for saving your life. This person is just a young man controlled by desire."
"Do you know why I came to save you?"
"I don't know? But since senior saved me, my life belongs to senior. But if senior asks me to do something evil, please forgive me and obey."
Zhao Fan has never met this person before. Since this person is willing to save him, there must be a reason.
When Hei Da heard this, his eyes were filled with admiration.
good!
He is repaying kindness, has principles, and his talent is extremely powerful.
Only my master is fit to teach this man!
When Hei Da was about to speak and explain the reason, the Zhao family members who had just been swept away by Hei Qi's momentum rushed in again.
At this time, Zhao Kong's mother rushed in, scanned the room, and found that there were only two people, one was Zhao Fan, and the other should be the person who had just attacked.
She didn't notice her talented son, and then looked at the blood mist scattered on the ground next to her, and seemed to understand something.
"Kong'er!"
Suddenly, an extremely miserable cry resounded over the Zhao family's residence.
Zhao Kong's mother's eyes were red, revealing her cultivation at the fifth level of the Yuan Shen realm, and she was killing Zhao Fan with gusts of wind.
Zhao Kong's father also followed closely behind.
"I want you dead!"
Her son died, and the son who she imagined would be famous all over the world in the future turned into a ball of blood mist.
If it wasn't for this little beast, how could her son have died tragically? It must have been the man who was invited by this little beast.
Kill Zhao Fan first!
Kill the big man in black again!
